pr_title: Restart UWP as user when started from Task Manager
pr_body:
**Resolved / Related Issues**
Items resolved / related issues by this PR.
- Closes #3117

**Details of Changes**
Add details of changes here.
- If UWP app detects it's being run as admin, it restarts as normal user. Causes splash screen being shown twice when using "open file location" from task manager, but unavoidable.

**Validation**
How did you test these changes?
- [x] Built and ran the app
pr_comments: @gave92 this always open a new instance of Files, even if already exists at least one opened. I guess this is something unavoidable too, right?

@BanCrash apparently not that unavoidable 😂 I was under the assumption that the method in 36a2b32 would just not work but it seems alright (in Release too) and it solves the issue, thanks for pointing it out!

issue_context.title: Files not opening File location from Task manager.
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug**
Files not opening File location from Task manager.

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behaviour:
1. Open Task Manager
2. Right click on any task
3. Click on 'Open File location'

**Expected behaviour**
Files should open the file location of the task.

**Desktop**
 - OS Version: Windows 10 20H2 19042.746
 - App version: 1.1.0.0

**Log file**
[debug.txt](https://github.com/files-community/Files/files/5826379/debug.txt)
comments: @Trustery Did you follow the [documentation](https://files-community.github.io/docs/#/articles/replace-file-explorer) to set Files as the default file manager?
Yes I did. Files is working for anything else, but when I click on "Open File location" in task manager you can see In the taskbar that Files open briefly but close immediately afterwards.

@yaichenbaum Interesting, task manager tries to start Files with administrator privileges! But that sadly fails :)

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/9673091/104858387-f6d55880-591e-11eb-98ba-fbe017cec600.png)
@gave92 if that's the case, this may be a UWP limiation that we can't work around.
@Trustery this issue should be resolved with #6530.

review_comments:
Not a dumb question at all, it should work as [the docs](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/api/system.security.principal.windowsbuiltinrole?redirectedfrom=MSDN&view=windowsdesktop-5.0) say:
`The code returns false if you are in the standard user role, even if you are in the Built-in Administrators group`

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/9673091/137907882-b5a735fb-c7da-4e32-a934-0625ecc89657.png)

@gave92 thank you for the clarification! It seems that I was looking on the wrong place, I watched [this doc](https://docs.microsoft.com/es-es/dotnet/api/system.web.security.roleprincipal.isinrole?view=netframework-4.8)
